q1.explanationZh: 第一段说他原来215公斤，14个月减了91公斤，所以是 215−91=124 公斤。

evidence.quote: Then, in only 14 months, he had lost 91 kilogrammes.

q2.sampleAnswer: His idol Bert Kreischer's weight loss success and the call to challenge inspired him to lose weight.
q2.rubricZh: 要点：偶像Bert减肥成功并号召大家挑战他，激励了他。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段说他听到偶像 Bert 两个月瘦了18公斤，还号召大家来挑战。他想：Bert 能瘦，我也行，就决定减肥。

evidence.quote: If he could successfully lose weight, then I can, too.

keyPoints.descZh: 偶像Bert Kreischer减肥成功并号召大家挑战他，激励了Hinds
examples: Bert Kreischer’s weight loss and the call to challenge inspired him

q3.sampleAnswer: Encouragement from his friends and family helped to keep him going.
q3.rubricZh: 要点：朋友和家人的鼓励。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段最后一句直接说，是朋友和家人的鼓励帮他坚持下去。

evidence.quote: Encouragement from his friends and family helped to keep him going.

examples: Encouragement from his friends and family

q4.sampleAnswer: When he weighed 215 kilogrammes, Hinds had problems such as people avoiding sitting next to him on the metro, friends making fun of him, and stores not carrying his size.
q4.rubricZh: 要点（共2分）：别人避开他、不愿挨着他坐；朋友取笑他、商店没有他的尺码。
q4.explanationZh: 第四段他回忆过去：别人看他就移开目光，在地铁上没人愿意坐他旁边，朋友取笑他，商店也没有他的尺码。

keyPoints.descZh: 别人避开他、不愿和他同坐/看到他就移开目光
examples: no one wants to sit next to him

keyPoints.descZh: 朋友取笑他，商店没有他的尺码

q5.sampleAnswer: Because many people regard him as their role model, and he doesn't want to let them down.
q5.rubricZh: 要点：很多人把他当榜样，他不想让他们失望。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一段他说大家把他当榜样，如果体重反弹，就会让这些人失望，所以他不允许自己反弹。

evidence.quote: If I regain weight, I’ll let down all those people!

keyPoints.descZh: 很多人把他当榜样，他不想让他们失望

q6.sampleAnswer: It's important to have a role model because they can provide motivation and support. It's also important for us to set goals and stick to the plan, so that we'll achieve success. (Answers may vary.)
q6.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可，至少两句：如（1）有榜样能带来动力和支持；（2）设定目标并坚持计划才能成功。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题。可以从文章学到：有榜样会有动力，朋友家人的鼓励很重要，还要定目标、每天坚持。要写至少两句话。

evidence.quote: Every day, Hinds shared his weigh-ins, workouts, and meals online.

keyPoints.descZh: 一条合理的启示（如榜样/鼓励带来动力和支持）
examples: It is important to have a role model.

keyPoints.descZh: 另一条合理的启示（如设定目标并坚持计划）
examples: We should set goals and stick to the plan.

q7.explanationZh: 空在 I 和动词 go 之间，修饰动词要用副词 regularly（经常）。句意：我经常慢跑来保持健康。
q7.tipsZh: regular → regularly 形容词变副词

q8.explanationZh: 空在 very 和 computer business 之间，修饰名词用形容词 successful（成功的）。

q9.explanationZh: like sb. doing/to do sth. 喜欢某人做某事，所以填 challenging 或 to challenge。句意：她不喜欢有人质疑她的想法。

q10.explanationZh: Would you mind doing sth.? 介意做某事吗？mind 后面要用动名词 sharing。
q10.tipsZh: mind doing sth. 介意做某事

q11.explanationZh: be meant to be done 是被动结构，所以填过去分词 viewed。句意：这些画是要从远处看的。
q11.tipsZh: be meant to be + 过去分词

q12.explanationZh: have always 后面接过去分词，构成现在完成时，所以把 encouragement 变成动词 encouraged。句意：我父母在我选职业时一直鼓励我。

q13.explanationZh: 对画线的“24 million（2400万）”和 times 提问次数，用 How many times。

q14.explanationZh: 原句是一般过去时 went，改一般疑问句要借助 Did，后面动词还原成 go：Did he go on to call on people to challenge him?
q14.tipsZh: 一般过去时的疑问句：Did + 主语 + 动词原形

q15.explanationZh: 间接引语改直接引语，人称改成 I，he had lost 变成现在完成时 I have lost：Bert Kreischer said, “I have lost 18 kilogrammes in two months.”
q15.tipsZh: 间接引语变直接引语要改人称和时态

q16.explanationZh: “如果他能成功减肥，那我也能”，用 so can I 表示“我也一样”。
q16.tipsZh: so + 助动词/情态动词 + 主语：……也一样

q17.explanationZh: I’ll 是 I will，变否定是 I won’t let down all those people.
q17.tipsZh: will 的否定式 won’t（will not）

q18.explanationZh: if 引导条件句：If he fails to lose weight, he will let his friends down. 也可以把主句放前面：He will let down his friends if he fails to lose weight.
q18.tipsZh: fail to do sth. 没能做到某事；let sb. down 让某人失望
